item.title: [B·image] I’VE CREATED A NEW LANGUAGE THAT AI AGENTS CAN’T READ. it’s a variatio
item.description:
I’VE CREATED A NEW LANGUAGE THAT AI AGENTS CAN’T READ.

it’s a variation of Wingdings called ✂️🦀📫.

10 reasons why this is necessary + good:

1) AI has gotten too comfortable knowing what i'm talking about. people trying to scrape my swag.

2) my linkedin password is now ✈️✈️✈️🏠.

3) there is no symbol for “you're fired.”

4) hard to automate my job when the instructions are lil scissors.

🛴) i can finally put bilingual on my resume.

6) every NDA is now a treasure map.

7) this is our CEO: 🖨️☂︎

8) i've translated my will. whoever figures out the snowflake gets my kids.

9) linguists are already calling it “please change the font back" and "worse than comic sans" and "🦔🔪"

10) if AI cracks it, i have a second language in development called Wingdings 2.

item.title: [B·video] Truly mind blown by OpenAI's ChatGPT Images 2.5 and Astra. We're 2 fee
item.description:
Truly mind blown by OpenAI's ChatGPT Images 2.5 and Astra. We're 2 feet firmly planted in the age of AGI.

This is literally just my taste and my judgment Wispr Flow'd out.

Here's the prompt:

"kid having good time at playground with plastic stegosaurus then drops it. light wood mulch stuff. sun moon sun moon sun moon. rain. toy gets destroyed.

man finds it puts on dash. radio on windows down beach sunglasses smile. cool edit to black. STEGOSAURUS with the US at the end all caps. logo like codex/claude but a stegosaurus or something abstract.

then warp speed backwards meteor earth to world to galaxy. action figure style."

the real life story is something i've been thinking a lot about. hope the impact is as outsized on you as it is on me. 🫶

you can just do things.
